issue: Inconsistent/missing auth gating - protected routes render blank page instead of sign-in prompt or redirect
actual: Behavior is inconsistent across protected actions while signed out: (1) Clicking 'Add to Cart' on a product detail page correctly redirects to /login and shows toast 'Please log in to add items to your cart' - PASS behavior. (2) Clicking 'Message Seller' opens the dialog but only disables the send button with label 'Log in to message' - no actual link/redirect to sign in, a UX dead-end. (3) Directly navigating to protected routes /create-listing, /cart, and /my-listings while signed out renders a completely blank page (only notification regions, no content, no redirect, no sign-in prompt) - these routes are not gated at all at the page level, leaving the user with no guidance or way to proceed. This fails the requirement that unauthenticated attempts be consistently blocked with a clear sign-in prompt or redirect.
